acceptance_criteria.criterion: Jede Tabelle hat eine RLS-Policy im selben Migrationsfile
Ein Tenant hat zu jedem Zeitpunkt mindestens einen Owner (DB-Constraint)
Integrationstest: RLS verweigert Zugriff auf fremden Tenant

review_findings.summary: enforce_tenant_has_owner_on_create() lacks the tenant-existence short-circuit its sibling has; insert-then-delete-in-same-tx wrongly aborts.
review_findings.required_correction: Add the same existence short-circuit before the owner count check.

residual_risks: service_role can still re-parent an Owner membership into a foreign tenant without that tenant's consent — ticket #8 (invitations) must not use raw UPDATE tenant_id as a transfer mechanism.
Integration suite only runs via the migration-check CI job, not root pnpm test.
authenticated has all-column UPDATE grant on tenants (RLS/FK make it harmless today, cosmetic tightening later).
note: Cycle 1 CHANGES_REQUESTED findings (SECURITY DEFINER pg_temp shadowing, owner re-parenting bypass) verified fixed independently against diff + CI logs (12/12 integration tests green on real Postgres).
